fullName.value: Nucleolar protein interacting with the FHA domain of pKI-67

texts.value: Binds to the FHA domain of MKI67; this interaction is enhanced in mitosis
Localizes to mitotic chromosomes in conjunction with MKI67

Sequentially phosphorylated on Thr-238, Thr-234 and Ser-230. Thr-234 is phosphorylated only when Thr-238 is phosphorylated. Likewise, phosphorylation at Ser-230 requires that Thr-234 and Thr-238 are phosphorylated. Phosphorylation enhances MKI67 binding
